messages:
Nina K.: Quick thread to lock DP recruitment + launch gates. Thinking: 12-day commitment window, mandatory onboarding smoke test, and three quant + qual touchpoints. goal: actionable engineering tickets + customer success playbook.

Ravi S.: 12 days ok. suggest two-step confirm: interest form then paid pledge. Paid pledge reduces drop-offs. propose $250 platform credit for pledge.

Nina K.: Yep paid pledge sounds good. pledge requires onboarding + 2 feedback sessions (week1 async pulse, week3 deep-dive).

Clara T.: Cohort composition idea: 6 startups (fast-feedback), 3 midsize, 3 enterprise (infrastructure signals). also ensure representation of vector-heavy workloads.

Evan H.: Deliverables for product handoff: weekly summary CSV (engagement + top issues), one aggregated bug ticket per customer with repro steps, and an ops health snapshot (latency, error-rate). dp-bot can drop a zipped payload to #product-dp-handoff.

Nina K.: Minimum activation definition: >=2 successful inference calls from production-like data OR >3000 tokens used in a single week. use that to decide go/no-go for follow-on pilot.

Ravi S.: Legal: opt-in NDA checkbox during pledge confirm + data retention 60 days default. I'll get a one-paragraph approved by Fri.

Clara T.: Measurement nuance: distinguish exploratory runs vs integrated usage. mark exploratory via checkbox in pulse.

dp-bot: Scheduled: `Commit window ends in 3 days` :bell:

Evan H.: For tooling: I'll add a webhook that sends pulse summary + top 5 auto-classified issues to #product-dp-handoff. will include sample payload w/ anonymized ids.

Nina K.: Next steps: Ravi -> legal blurb, Evan -> webhook prototype, Clara -> cohort roster & invite prioritization, Nina -> invite copy and pledge flow. Target: open interest form next Tue.

Ravi S.: ack.

Evan H.: ack, prototype by Mon.

Clara T.: will share roster by EOD Thu.

Nina K.: Thanks team — aim to close commit window in two weeks and start onboarding the week after. flag anything blocking now. :rocket:
